description:
Point-of-sale desktop app for small retail stores in the Philippines


Financial reorg release. The money side of KPOS moves out of scattered panels into one Money & Reports hub, and gains a real month-end close.
What's new
Money & Reports hub (FIN-HUB) — Overview, Sales, Expenses, Cash Flow, Purchases, Logs, Advisor and Close in one place, laid out the way an accounting app is. The old Financials, Reports and Books panels stay reachable; nothing was taken away.
Month-end close (FIN-CLOSE) — close a month and it locks. Every financial write path respects the lock, so a closed month can't drift after the fact. Reopen is there when you need it.
Money Transfer float reconciliation (MT-RECON) — count each e-cash account against its live wallet balance at end of day. A shortage becomes an OPEX expense, an overage goes pending. Store sales are never touched.
Sidelines P&L (T-B3) — track micro-businesses you run alongside the store (a machine, a rental, a small resell line) with their own profit-and-loss and payback line, plus a printable combined report. Off by default; switch it on in Settings.
Insights hardening (S2) — four fixes on the Insights tab:
- A transaction with no line-items could freeze the entire tab on "Calculating…". It no longer can, and the malformed rows are repaired on load and on backup import.
- Product, category, cashier, expense-type and staff names are now escaped everywhere they're displayed. A name containing markup is shown as text instead of being interpreted.
- The Credit/Utang Health card no longer sits empty on a brand-new store with utang switched off.
- Search: clearing the box restores every card it should.

Install
Download KPOS-Setup.zip, extract it, then run the installer inside.
Existing installs update in place.
